alt: Two arrays side by side, one updated by a direct loop that writes every index in each range, one by a difference array that writes only two entries per update. Each step marks the cells written and gives the running write counts, so a wide range costs the direct loop many writes and diff two.

steps.caption: Both methods start from 5 zeros and face the same 3 updates. The direct loop writes every index in each range. The difference array writes two entries per update.
Update [0, 2] by 3. The direct loop writes 3 cells, 3 in total so far. diff writes diff[0] and diff[3], 2 in total so far.
Update [1, 4] by 2. The direct loop writes 4 cells, 7 in total so far. diff writes diff[1] and diff[5], 4 in total so far.
Update [3, 3] by 1. The direct loop writes 1 cell, 8 in total so far. diff writes diff[3] and diff[4], 6 in total so far.
After 3 updates the direct loop made 8 writes; diff made 6 plus one 5-step rebuild, 11 in all. Both end at [3, 5, 5, 3, 2].
Both methods start from 7 zeros and face the same 3 updates. The direct loop writes every index in each range. The difference array writes two entries per update.
Update [0, 6] by 2. The direct loop writes 7 cells, 7 in total so far. diff writes diff[0] and diff[7], 2 in total so far.
Update [1, 5] by 3. The direct loop writes 5 cells, 12 in total so far. diff writes diff[1] and diff[6], 4 in total so far.
Update [0, 6] by 1. The direct loop writes 7 cells, 19 in total so far. diff writes diff[0] and diff[7], 6 in total so far.
After 3 updates the direct loop made 19 writes; diff made 6 plus one 7-step rebuild, 13 in all. Both end at [3, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 3].
Both methods start from 6 zeros and face the same 2 updates. The direct loop writes every index in each range. The difference array writes two entries per update.
Update [2, 2] by 5. The direct loop writes 1 cell, 1 in total so far. diff writes diff[2] and diff[3], 2 in total so far.
Update [4, 4] by 1. The direct loop writes 1 cell, 2 in total so far. diff writes diff[4] and diff[5], 4 in total so far.
After 2 updates the direct loop made 2 writes; diff made 4 plus one 6-step rebuild, 10 in all. Both end at [0, 0, 5, 0, 1, 0].
